articles.summary: After a six-year hiatus, Union Pacific's Living Legend No. 844 is returning to the rails. The legendary steam locomotive will join Big Boy No. 4014 for Union Pacific's historic holiday tour this November, marking the first public appearance for No. 844 since the pair traveled together in 2019 to celebrate the 150th anniversary of the driving of the Golden Spike in Utah.
articles.title: No. 844 to Reunite with Big Boy for Holiday Tour | Union Pacific

articles.summary: Former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer recently raised questions about what our proposed combination with Norfolk Southern means for railroad workers and customers. Those questions deserve a straight answer, so let’s put them on the table.
articles.title: Let's Talk Facts About the Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger
